title: General annotated NNRC to DNNRC correctness specialised to the top translation
intent: Prove the NNRC-to-DNNRC translation correct once, over the general base translation parameterised by the annotation, the plug type and both environments; the top-level compiler theorem nnrc_to_dnnrc_top_correct then falls out as a trivial specialisation of that general lemma.

parent.name: nnrc_to_dnnrc_top_correct
parent.statement:
Theorem nnrc_to_dnnrc_top_correct h (tenv:vdbindings) (q:nnrc) :
      forall cdenv:dbindings,
        wf_cdenv tenv cdenv ->
        nnrc_eval_top h q (unlocalize_constants cdenv) =
        dnnrc_eval_top h (nnrc_to_dnnrc_top tenv q) cdenv.

children.name: nnrc_to_dnnrc_base_correct_lift
children.statement:
Lemma nnrc_to_dnnrc_base_correct_lift {A plug_type:Set} (annot:A) {plug:AlgPlug plug_type} h (ctenv tenv:list (var*dlocalization)) (n:nnrc) :
    forall cdenv denv:list (var*ddata),
      wf_cdenv ctenv cdenv ->
      wf_denv tenv denv ->
      nnrc_core_eval h (unlocalize_constants cdenv) (unlocalize_constants denv) n
      = lift unlocalize_data (dnnrc_base_eval h cdenv denv (nnrc_to_dnnrc_base annot ctenv tenv n)).
children.closed_by: rewrite <- nnrc_to_dnnrc_base_correct; auto (then unfold unlocalize_data/lift and destruct the evaluation)
children.note: The general lemma the top theorem instantiates: correctness over arbitrary annot, plug_type, ctenv, tenv, cdenv, denv. children.name: wf_cdenv_rec_sort
children.statement:
Lemma wf_cdenv_rec_sort tenv cdenv :
      wf_cdenv tenv cdenv -> wf_cdenv (rec_sort tenv) (rec_sort cdenv).
children.closed_by: apply same_domain_rec_sort; rewrite assoc_lookupr_drec_sort (in both lookups); assumption
children.note: Discharges the general lemma's wf_cdenv side condition for the rec-sorted environments. Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: wf_cdenv is preserved by applying rec_sort to both environments.

applicability.goal_shape: A top-level theorem 'forall args, wf ... -> eval_top (translate_top args) = eval_top' args' whose proof, by unfolding the top-level evaluators and the top translation, reduces to a general lemma 'forall {A plug_type} annot ctenv tenv, wf ... -> core_eval(...) = core_eval'(...)' proved over the base translation.
applicability.use_when: the base translation is parameterised by an annotation type and a plug type (or by section variables) and the top-level entry point only fixes those parameters and the environments; the top statement is exactly the general lemma with those parameters filled in.
applicability.avoid_when: the top translation does more than fill parameters (extra top-level wrapping, e.g. normalisation), in which case each wrapper needs its own commutation lemma before instantiation applies; the general lemma is not yet proved (then its proof is the real cost, not the specialisation); or the parameter substitution is not definitional and needs a non-trivial rewrite between two representations.

consequences: The cost of the move is concentrated in the general lemma (here nnrc_to_dnnrc_base_correct, a 115-line induction over the expression, not shown as a child because the glue does not cite it directly). The top theorem then needs only the general lemma plus small bridge lemmas that reconcile the top-level environment forms with the general lemma's (rec_sort commutes with unlocalize_constants; wf_cdenv survives rec_sort; the empty environment is trivially well-formed). Failure mode: if the top-level evaluator wraps the core evaluator with extra normalisation the general lemma does not share, each wrapper needs its own commutation lemma before the instantiation applies, and those wrappers become the real content of the proof.
